'''Logor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] thug who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents traveled to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Morjanssik]] on Mon Calamari and began disrupting [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations in the [[City/Legends|city]], in an attempt to prevent Mon Calamari from supplying [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The agents, disguised as [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], hired Logor to attack a team of Alliance agents sent to Morjanssik to investigate the sabotage caused by the infiltrators. Logor hired a group of local Quarren thugs to attack the Alliance agents in the [[Long Drink]], a Morjanssik bar. Logor was present in the bar during the fight and he left during the confusion of the attack. He fled the scene on a [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] and was subsequently pursued by the agents.
